Sunworld Hòn Thơm is a cable car ride over open ocean, an Ancient Rome-themed shopping hub, AND a full island water park. All connected. All one ticket.

The cable car alone covers 7,899 meters, one of the longest sea-crossing cable cars on the planet.

Phu Quoc keeps pulling surprises. This is a big one.
